text:
nina: Quick sync  final SEO + launch ops checklist for the "Serving at Scale" webinar landing. Need owners for: keyword intent mapping, JSON-LD/schema, redirects + hreflang, canonical strategy, and UTMs. Who volunteers? :rocket:

omar: I can take keyword research + SERP intent mapping. Will return a prioritized CSV (intent, primary KW, alt KW, target H1/H2) by Mon. Will flag any competitive SERP features (people also ask, featured snippets).

tess: Ill own structured data + FAQ markup. Quick note: Event schema requires ISO startDate and a canonical stable URL. Ill drop a JSON-LD sample and the QA list.

kyle: Dev side: redirects + hreflang + canonical. If we change slugs for local markets we need 301s + proper hreflang tags. Also confirm whether /resources/ and /webinars/ both need to exist or should be consolidated.

maya: Ill own campaign taxonomy, UTMs, and GA4 conversion events. Proposing campaign name: serving_scale_2026_launch. Will share tagging matrix (email, blog, paid, partners).

ops-bot: Reminder: staging deploy window Wed 03:00-04:30 UTC. Add any redirect/nginx changes before Tue EOD to hit staging.

nina: High priority gotchas: 1) i18n slugs + hreflang interplay (kyle + omar to sync). 2) canonical when mirrored content exists (pick single canonical). 3) CTA funnels: internal links should not be more than 2 clicks from hero to trial.

omar: KW deliverable outline (CSV columns): intent_type, primary_kw, secondary_kw, longtail_kw, target_h1, target_h2, suggested_meta. Example row: "informational","webinar serving models","inference serving webinar","how to optimize LLM inference","Serving LLMs at scale","Why inference latency matters","meta: Serving LLMs at scale  Redwood Inference"

tess: JSON-LD sample (will publish exact in doc, shortened here): ```{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Serving at Scale","startDate":"2026-05-12T16:00:00Z","endDate":"2026-05-12T17:00:00Z","url":"https://www.redwood.com/webinars/serving-scale","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference","url":"https://www.redwood.com"}}```

tess: Also checklist: [ ] Event schema (startDate,endDate,url) [ ] FAQPage Q/A (5-8 questions matching copy) [ ] BreadcrumbList [ ] Organization + Logo markup [ ] Social meta tags (og:, twitter:).

kyle: Redirect + hreflang approach: prefer canonical at /webinars/serving-scale. If localized slugs exist, serve them with rel="alternate" hreflang tags and 302s from language index pages only; legacy /resources/ paths should 301 to canonical. nginx example: ```location = /resources/old-serving { return 301 https://www.redwood.com/webinars/serving-scale; }``` hreflang example (head): ```<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://www.redwood.com/webinars/serving-scale" /> <link rel="alternate" hreflang="es" href="https://www.redwood.com/es/webinars/servir-a-escala" />```

maya: UTM examples: email = ?utm_source=email&utm_medium=crm&utm_campaign=serving_scale_2026; blog teaser = ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=serving_scale_2026; paid = ?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=serving_scale_2026. GA4 conversion event: webinar_signup (params: method, campaign, kw_variant).

nina: Action items summary (due dates): [omar] KW CSV + intent notes (Mon EOD) | [tess] JSON-LD + FAQ Qs (Tue AM) | [kyle] redirect CSV + hreflang list + nginx snippets (Tue AM) | [maya] UTM tagging sheet + GA4 event plan (Mon PM) | [nina] promo channel list & content brief (today). Please drop deliverables in this thread and ping when pushed. :thumbsup:

omar: One blocker: SERP for "inference serving" dominated by vendor docs and pricing pages  we should prioritize longtail intent + webinar schema to get event rich result. Will include suggested headings that target questions.

kyle: Another blocker: localized redirect automation needs the redirect CSV (locale, old_path, new_path). If i18n team can't supply locale slugs by Tue morning we'll do manual mapping for top 3 locales.

tess: Quick copy note for Jamie/Copy team (cc @jamie): make sure FAQ answers include short, direct lines (40-60 words) so they render well in snippets. Also keep structured Qs matching KW phrasing.

maya: I'm adding UTM examples to the tracking doc and wiring up test events in staging. Will validate GA4 event params during Wed staging deploy.

nina: Thanks everyone. If no objections Ill lock canonical to /webinars/serving-scale and request 301s for any legacy /resources/ paths. Tag me when CSVs are up.

ops-bot: Deployment window confirmed for Wed 03:00-04:30 UTC. Any last-minute config must be in the PR by Tue 23:00 UTC to be included.

nina: Closing note: lets avoid deep linking to list pages from the hero  point all core CTAs directly at the signup flow. Well iterate copy after we see KW doc.
